verified_facts.text: The hotel's restaurants and lounges have bird's-eye views from Cambodia's tallest skyscraper.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rosewood Phnom Penh’s restaurants and lounges captivate with bold cuisine, distinct concepts, and stunning bird’s-eye views from Cambodia’s tallest skyscraper.

verified_facts.text: Iza brings the spirit of a Japanese izakaya, with a robata-yaki grill, sushi counter, noodle corner and a curated selection of sake.
verified_facts.excerpt: Iza brings the spirit of a Japanese izakaya to Phnom Penh, with a robata-yaki grill, sushi counter and noodle corner, as well as a curated selection of sake.

verified_facts.text: CUTS is a steakhouse with hand-cut meats, a signature grill room, private suites and a wine cellar with over 3,000 bottles.
verified_facts.excerpt: CUTS is an award-winning steakhouse in Phnom Penh, known for hand-cut meats, a signature grill room, private suites and a curated wine cellar with over 3,000 wine bottles.

verified_facts.text: Zhan Liang serves Cantonese, Sichuanese and Northern Chinese dishes and has a tea library and a signature roasting station.
verified_facts.excerpt: Zhan Liang is a Chinese restaurant in Phnom Penh with bold Cantonese, Sichuanese, and Northern dishes, a tea library and signature roasting station

verified_facts.text: Brasserie Louis pairs views with French comfort food and Cambodian favorites made with local ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Brasserie Louis pairs stunning views with French comfort food and Cambodian favorites, made with the finest local ingredients in the heart of Phnom Penh.

verified_facts.text: The Whisky Library is a cigar and whisky lounge offering rare single malts, 24 cigar varieties and skyline views.
verified_facts.excerpt: offering rare single malts, 24 cigar varieties, and a cozy, elegant space with skyline views.

verified_facts.text: Sora received the Ketel One Sustainable Bar Award 2025 for eco-mixology practices including zero-waste ingredients, local vermouth and in-house kombucha infusions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sora receives the Ketel One Sustainable Bar Award 2025 for pioneering eco-mixology practices—from zero-waste ingredients to local vermouth and in-house kombucha infusions.

verified_facts.text: Sora is a sky-high cocktail bar above the city.
A hydroponic garden on Level 9 supplies all of the hotel's greens.
verified_facts.excerpt: our hydroponic garden on Level 9 supplies 100% of the hotel's greens - harvested and on the plate within hours

verified_facts.text: The hotel's art gallery partners with leading and emerging artists to showcase Cambodian contemporary artworks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rosewood Phnom Penh partners with leading and emerging artists to showcase Cambodia’s most exciting contemporary artworks.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's curated art collection connects guests to the traditions of Cambodia.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel’s curated art collection connects guests to the charm, spirit, and traditions of Cambodia through the lens of a living, evolving canvas.

verified_facts.text: Premier River Rooms have Tonle Sap views, custom art, a marble bath and a walk-in shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Premier River Rooms boast fabled Tonle Sap views and chic 50 square meters living space. A refined, residential feel with custom art, marble bath, and walk-in shower

verified_facts.text: Mekong Suites have a king bed, a living room and views of the Mekong River.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mekong Suites offer private, residential-style comfort with a king bed, spacious living room, and stunning views of the legendary Mekong River.

verified_facts.text: The Norodom House has a grand foyer, sitting room, bedroom with dressing chamber, private study and dining room.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 225 square meters Norodom House offers refined living with a grand foyer, airy sitting room, elegant bedroom with dressing chamber, private study, and chic dining room.

verified_facts.text: Sense, A Rosewood Spa offers treatments inspired by traditional healing herbs and techniques.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sense, A Rosewood Spa offers a treatment series inspired by traditional healing herbs and techniques to restore and revitalize the body and mind.

verified_facts.text: A Khmer architectural tour explores Phnom Penh's 1960s heritage buildings aboard a traditional remork.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dive into Phnom Penh’s unique 60’s heritage and explore its landmark buildings aboard a traditional Remork.

verified_facts.text: A self-guided tour through Phnom Penh's historic heart follows a quest for a lost Khmer antique and a mysterious French adventurer.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step into the shoes of explorers on a quest for a lost Khmer antique and a mysterious French adventurer in this unique self-guided tour through Phnom Penh’s historic heart.

verified_facts.text: Living Room is an all-day lounge for artisan coffee, cakes and evening drinks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Living Room makes it the perfect venue to stop by for artisan coffee, cakes and sweet confections or a glass of your favorite evening tipple.
